correct.description: Arms start extended at the sides, elbows stay pinned to the torso while curling to full flexion, controlled tempo throughout

common_errors.description: Elbows drift forward away from the torso instead of staying pinned
Torso rocks or swings to help generate momentum instead of an isolated curl
Curl does not reach full flexion at the top

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated.

rep_counting._note: Field NAMES match every other contract's rep_counting shape (top_position_criterion/bottom_position_criterion), but a curl's rest/reference position is the EXTENDED-arm position, which is the schema's usual "bottom_position_criterion" wording -- kept as-is for field-name consistency; the VALUES describe the real curl-specific meaning. phases/rep_complete_transition are written starting from the extended rest position to match.

coaching_cues.setup: Stand tall, arms extended, elbows at your sides
coaching_cues.execution: Curl up with control, keep elbows still
coaching_cues.set_complete_no_flags: Great set. Elbows locked in place.
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.elbow_drift: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides
flag_cues.torso_swing: Stand still, no rocking the torso

elbow_injury.modification: Reduce weight and range of motion. Stop if you feel elbow pain.

wrist_injury.modification: Use a neutral-grip (hammer) variation to reduce wrist strain.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you curl up.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. wrist curl compensation, asymmetric curling speed). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.
